summary: Backend-only verification of the NEW DELETE /api/auth/account endpoint. 36/36 tests pass (24 existing backend_test + 6 tasks regression + 6 new delete-account tests). Verified: (1) missing JWT returns 401; (2) wrong password returns 401 and the user + JWT still work afterward; (3) solo-family delete cascades — response returns family_deleted=true, the family + shared tasks/rewards/events/shopping/completions/penalties/claims are all wiped, subsequent login with the same email returns 401 and the previous JWT no longer resolves via /auth/me; (4) multi-member delete leaves the family intact — response returns family_deleted=false, GET /api/family excludes the deleted member, remaining parent still logs in, deleted child login returns 401; (5) demo accounts (papa@demo.fr, lea@demo.fr) still log in and GET /api/tasks returns Léa's tasks with today_status populated. No demo data was disturbed — all deletion tests use freshly-registered TEST_ users. Minor observation: backend lowercases emails on register (register+auth/me case-normalize) — not a bug, but test assertions were made case-insensitive.

minor.issue: Emails are silently normalized to lowercase on storage. Client-provided casing is not preserved. Not a bug for this feature, but worth documenting so UI can display the normalized value.
Optional `token` query param declared but ignored; RN <Image> on web can't send Authorization headers → proof photos may 401 in browser preview. (Pre-existing.)
Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event handlers. Prefer lifespan context manager. (Pre-existing.)

action_items: No action needed for account-deletion feature — endpoint behaves per spec (password verify, cascade only when family becomes empty, correct family_deleted flag).
(Carry-over) Honor `?token=` in GET /api/photos/{path} so RN <Image> on web preview can render proofs.
(Carry-over) Migrate FastAPI startup/shutdown handlers to lifespan context manager.
critical_code_review_comments: delete_account (server.py:273-291) correctly re-fetches the user doc to run passwords.verify against the current password_hash — does not trust the JWT alone.

Cascade order is correct: user + personal records (completions/penalties/claims by user_id) are removed FIRST, then remaining member count is recomputed on users collection to decide family_deleted. Race is unlikely at family-scale traffic.
When family becomes empty, all family-scoped collections (tasks, rewards, events, shopping, completions, penalties, claims) are deleted by family_id — no orphan documents left behind.
Response body {ok, family_deleted} is minimal and matches what the DeleteAccountModal expects.

One improvement to consider (not blocking): after successful deletion, the caller's JWT remains valid for its exp window against /auth/me — but /auth/me raises 401 because the user doc is gone (verified in test). So there is no practical session-leak.
seed_data_creation: All temp users are registered with TEST_del_<uuid>@ex.com prefix and are deleted at the end of each test (either as the assertion itself or as explicit teardown). No residual TEST_ users or families are left in the DB. Demo accounts (papa/lea/hugo/emma@demo.fr) were only used for read-only login/tasks regression and were NOT deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DELETE /api/auth/account is fully covered in /app/backend/tests/test_delete_account.py — reuse for regression. Full suite runs in ~7s (pytest-xdist, 2 workers). Note: test_tasks_regression.py reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL as a required env var and errors on collection if unset — export it before running that file standalone. backend_test.py and test_delete_account.py both have a safe default fallback.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature works as specified. No production bug found.
